description: Returns all MAX accounts and group chats linked to the Statuser account, with status and the "used for 2FA" flag. Available as a notification channel in notification rules. A non-null `disabled_reason` means the messenger refuses delivery to this chat (`bot_blocked`, `user_deactivated`, `chat_not_found`, `bot_kicked`, `no_rights`): no notifications go there. It is fixed in the messenger and confirmed by a channel test in the Statuser panel.
name: max_linked_list
title: List linked MAX accounts
